article.headline: Randall Pettus II scores 20, Elon knocks off Morehead State 84-61
article.description: — Randall Pettus II had 20 points in Elon’s 84-61 victory over Morehead State on Saturday.
article.linkText: Randall Pettus II scores 20, Elon knocks off Morehead State 84-61
article.story: ELON, N.C. -- — Randall Pettus II had 20 points in Elon’s 84-61 victory over Morehead State on Saturday. Pettus shot 7 for 13 (4 for 7 from 3-point range) and 2 of 3 from the free-throw line for the Phoenix (3-3). Josh Dalton scored 19 points while going 7 of 12 and 4 of 4 from the free-throw line, and added three blocks. Bryson Cokley shot 4 for 7 from beyond the arc to finish with 12 points. Clayton Parker led the way for the Eagles (3-4) with 24 points, 13 rebounds and two steals. Vince Dawson III added 10 points for Morehead State. Izaiah Day finished with seven points. Elon took the lead for good about 6 1/2 minutes into the game and the score was 41-31 at halftime, with Pettus racking up 10 points. Elon extended its lead to 54-35 during the second half, fueled by an 8-0 scoring run. Dalton scored a team-high 13 points in the second half. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
